evaluation.weighted_metrics: not a primary endpoint; never synthesize missing IA

disclosed_adaptations: Keep evidence.other and relation.other as separately named raw/propagated channels; avoid flattened file-name overwrites.
Read true raw category inputs for raw channels instead of duplicating the propagated files.
Apply existing native fixed-model-axis exact/alternative-ID expansion before source grouping; preserve alias priority and duplicate MAX.
Use CPU ABI execution of the exact count-kernel C operation, with source-pinned traversal.
Store boolean channels separately and expand only fetched rows beside the unchanged eight parent features.

bounded_feature_extension.input_gap: one membership flag discards evidence-code, relation and active annotation/child-branch patterns
bounded_feature_extension.model: one additional native eight-layer GCN with in_goa40; same hidden size, embeddings, loss, optimizer, epochs, batch, seed, SWA and soft postprocessing
bounded_feature_extension.native_math: unchanged source nonexperimental grouping and source C count-kernel body/traversal
bounded_feature_extension.qualification: source and invented-data qualification before real feature generation and the additional fit; every choice before new-reference opening
bounded_feature_extension.scope: same 4040-prior universe, 3557 native-root-positive training rows, 797 consumed validation and complete3300 final targets

learning.checkpoint_averaging: unchanged native uniform parameter average of best three validation checkpoints
learning.component_semantics: two marginal, not conditional, prediction channels; native four features each
learning.context: one native nonexperimental GOA channel, NOT excluded, projected on the fixed model axis
learning.fit_candidates: all 6437 earlier forecast proteins, excluding both complete validation and final target frames
learning.fixed_published_postprocessing: author notebook pure-GO soft closure: independent MAX and MIN at .7 closure + .3 raw, then equal mean; no top-k/TTA/GOA merge
learning.labels: known T0 experimental repertoire UNION already consumed CAFA5 development additions
learning.loss: unchanged native mean BCEWithLogitsLoss; unlabeled zero is a benchmark convention
learning.model_axis: fixed historical January2023 ontology at training and every inference
learning.native_aspect_row_filter: after full-universe priors, train only rows positive for the source driver first parentless literal GO ID
learning.postprocessing_controls: apply the same fixed soft closure to parent/mixture controls; retain literal raw LocalPlus and raw DeepGO scores separately
learning.postprocessing_limits: float32 rounding is recorded; soft closure does not guarantee parent score >= child score
learning.postprocessing_selection: choose checkpoints and architecture using deployed soft outputs on consumed validation only
learning.pretest_model_choice: higher consumed-validation SWA score; MF/CC choose native GCN or MLP, BP additionally admits one qualified coded-context GCN; exact ties prefer MLP, then original one-channel GCN, then coded-context GCN

learning.raw_parent_control_scope: complete literal source heads and original score precision; model-axis canonicalized raw controls remain separately named
learning.simple_mixture_control: alpha0.0-1.0 by0.1 on the same consumed validation frame and fixed model axis; smallest-alpha tie; no final-test tuning

training_freshness_controls.attribution: gain versus retained parent alone does not identify learned integration beyond fresher labels or prevalence
training_freshness_controls.frequency: broadcast exact existing full4040 marginal prior bytes, computed before root filtering; Naive-style prevalence control without fitting

training_freshness_controls.updated_localplus_soft: same fixed notebook soft processing on the fixed model ontology; preserve raw updated scores separately

learning.validation: consumed Sep2025-Mar2026 PK frame, excluding every new final accession/input duplicate
learning.validation_objective_adaptation: ordinary native PK micro-Fmax, thresholds .01-.99 by .01

limits: This is retrospective, not prospective or wholly developer-blind; older 2026 GOA source QC was previously performed.
Protein/input exclusions do not establish base-checkpoint training or study independence.

The author trained the original stacker on out-of-fold parent forecasts; these historical parent forecasts are not guaranteed out of fold for all known labels. This is a temporal-stacking adaptation, not a reproduction.
GOA is reused source context already represented by Pharos, not independent corroboration.
Missing curator matches do not establish biological falsehood.
Neither GO recovery nor a component gain establishes whole-graph or clinical accuracy.
Challenge same-learner KG link prediction remains a separate evaluated task.
No automatic graph acceptance, biological pruning or app-default promotion follows a positive metric.
